dataset.name: Targeted processed Schedule A API observations
dataset.description: Exact-field OpenFEC observations used for targeted lookup, fixture capture, processing-lag evidence, and comparison sampling; not the complete processed baseline.

acquisition.pagination: Keyset pagination. Preserve count, exactness, last_contribution_receipt_date, last_index, per_page, and every response page. The endpoint does not advertise file_number as a filter; filing-scoped fixtures use the preserved listing image range plus committee and transaction period, then verify every returned file_number.

partitions.name: api_observation
partitions.source: Credential-free request parameters, retrieval timestamp, response headers, response-body digest, and all keyset pages.
partitions.purpose: Identify exactly what the mutable processed API exposed at one observation boundary.

partitions.name: two_year_transaction_period
partitions.source: Exact query parameter and value returned on every result.
partitions.purpose: Bound targeted lookup and map observations to downstream period calculations without replacing receipt or report time.

acquisition.retry_policy: Use bounded retries and publisher rate-limit headers. Retain failed requests. A zero-result observation is accepted only with HTTP success, exact count, complete pagination, the complete request parameter set, and an observation timestamp; it means no rows were returned then, not that rows can never appear.

physical_schema.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; parse numbers with their lexical representation intact before any domain conversion.
physical_schema.empty_record_policy: Every result becomes an API occurrence or an explicit issue. A successful exact zero-result page remains first-class processing-lag evidence.
physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve absent, null, empty text, false, zero, and empty nested objects or arrays independently. The observed API permits null original_sub_id although its pinned Swagger definition marks that field as a non-null string; observed source values take precedence and the mismatch remains documented.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Pinned OpenFEC Swagger SHA-256 b933e5ba144a9b3b63b19b902e7ad4d4032507022826d93ddde6dca5918b9485 plus the 81 observed Schedule A result fields and API keyset envelope.

identity.publisher_record_key: sub_id within the observed processed API projection
identity.record_version: API observation ID + sub_id + SHA-256 of the complete canonical result object
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every page occurrence. Equal sub_id and equal content may deduplicate only inside one complete observation index. Conflicting content, repeated result placement, or one sub_id with several file numbers remains explicit and blocks use as reconciliation evidence.

time_fields.meaning: Processed transaction period, independent of report and receipt dates.
Publisher processing timestamp without an explicit source offset in observed results.
Legal Tender request and response time; it bounds what the mutable API exposed.

money_fields.meaning: Processed Schedule A receipt amount for this source record; counting still depends on a named calculation.
money_fields.unit: USD JSON number preserved lexically, then lossless reported_point

money_fields.meaning: Processed contributor accumulator. It is comparison content, not another receipt flow.
money_fields.unit: USD JSON number preserved lexically, then lossless reported accumulator

code_fields.meaning: Processed action code; observed A means ADD and does not identify the as-filed cover disposition.
Processed row filing number returned by the API; verify it after image-range selection because it is not an advertised filter.
Processed filing transaction references retained for reconciliation; neither is a global event ID.
Processed memo assertion and API helper; preserve both.
Processed filing placement and report assertions.

rules: This endpoint is targeted processed evidence, not the complete processed Schedule A baseline and not a routine bulk incremental feed.
Preserve complete response pages and all top-level result fields before mapping selected values to the 81-field processed relation contract.
Preserve nested committee and contributor master expansions as returned, but exclude them from Schedule A record identity and reconciliation comparison because they are mutable convenience joins.

Never interpret an exact zero-result image-range observation as permanent absence. It is a time-bounded raw_only_pending_processing candidate until a later processed snapshot or observation closes it.

Do not treat amendment_indicator as the raw document's new, amendment, or termination disposition. The exact original filing fixture returns amendment_indicator A/ADD for every processed row although its raw cover is F3XN.
Do not invent dump-only values, tsvectors, SQL nullability, relation ordinals, or processed snapshot completeness from an API response.

Use file_number, committee_id, transaction_id, image_number, form/line, date, amount, back references, and content only as explicit reconciliation signals. A separate calculation owns match decisions.
Keep API observation, load, receipt, report, election, and raw filing times independent.

revisions.publisher_model: The API is a mutable projection of processed FEC data. Rows can appear, change, disappear, or gain publisher coding after a raw filing is received.
revisions.effective_projection: API observations may support targeted reconciliation states but cannot establish complete processed coverage. Accepted publication still requires a pinned processed dump snapshot and its relation contract.

checks.rule: Every accepted response conforms to page.schema.json and every result exposes the complete contracted top-level field set.
Credential-free parameters, observation time, status, response headers, body digest, and retry evidence are retained.
is_count_exact is true, every keyset page is present exactly once, and conserved result count equals pagination.count.
Every non-empty result in a filing image-range observation has the expected committee ID, transaction period, and file_number; unrelated rows remain preserved as issues rather than silently filtered.
Every result has one non-empty decimal sub_id unique within the complete observation.
Unknown top-level fields and observed type/nullability differences from pinned Swagger require review without losing the response.
Mutable committee and contributor expansions remain stored but cannot affect Schedule A row identity or content comparison.
A complete zero-result page is retained with its exact filing image range and becomes pending evidence, never permanent nonexistence.

scenarios: 23 exact processed rows for raw original file 1997074
processed action A/ADD on raw F3XN source
mutable nested committee and contributor expansions
raw amendment file 2009982 not yet exposed by processed API
time-bounded processing lag rather than permanent absence

use.retention: Retain exact response bytes and transport metadata at runtime. Contract fixtures retain every API value in stable indented JSON without credentials. Keep zero-result observations and later superseding observations indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: A targeted API observation describes the mutable processed rows returned for one query at one time. It neither proves complete processed coverage nor replaces raw filings or a pinned processed dump snapshot.
